5106:
[נוא] _vb_. **hinder**, **restrain**, **frustrate**
**Qal** but read Hiph.
**Hiph**.
**1.** **restrain**, **forbid** (performance of vow); **frustrate** (device of people); **refuse**
**2.** **refrain**, **make averse** the heart
5107:
[נוּב] _vb_. **bear fruit** (poet.)
**Qal** only fig., abs. of righteous under fig. of tree; if wealth **beareth fruit**; **beareth the fruit of** wisdom.
**Po‛l**. fig. for **makes to flourish**.
5108: נוֹב Kt (Qr נִיב, q.v.) _n.[m.]_ **fruit**;—cstr. [[23-isaiah.57.19|Is 57:19]] **fruit of lips** (fig. for thanksgiving).
5109: נוֹבָ֑י _n.pr.m_. a chief of people [[16-nehemiah.10.20|Ne 10:20]] Qr נִיבָ֑י
5110:
נוּד _vb_. **move to and fro**, **wander**, **shudder**, **shew grief**
**Qal**
**1.**
**a.** **move to and fro**, **wander** aimlessly, as fugitive
**b.** **flutter**
**c.** **waver**, **wave**, **shake**
**2.** **shew grief** (i.e. by shaking or nodding head)
**Hiph**.
**1.** **cause to wander** aimlessly, as fugitives
**2.** **make a wagging**, **wag** with the head
**Hoph**. and the worthless, **like briers made to flutter** (tossed away) are they
**Hithpo‛lel**
**1.** **move oneself to and fro**, **sway**, **totter**
**2.** **shake oneself**, in excitement
**3.** **bemoan oneself**
5113: נוֹד appar. _n.pr.terr_. [[01-genesis.4.16|Gn 4:16]] of region into which Cain wandered
5116:
נָוֶה _n.m_. **abode of shepherd**, or **flocks**, poet. **habitation**
**1.**
**a.** **abode**, of sheep
**b.** **abode of shepherds**
**c.** = **meadow**
**2.** **habitation**, usu. of country, or of domains in the country (chiefly poet.)
5117:
נוּחַ _vb_. **rest**
**Qal**
**1.** **rest**, **settle down and remain**
**2.** **repose**, **be quiet**, **have rest**
**Hiph**.
**A.**
**1.** **cause to rest** = **give rest** to
**2.** **cause to rest** (i.e. **light**) upon
**B.**
**1.** **lay** or **set down**, **deposit**, **let lie**
**2.** **let remain**, **leave** (in present condition)
**3.** **leave** = depart from
**4.** **abandon**
**5.** **let alone** (refrain from interfering with)
**6.** **permit**
**Hoph**.
**A.** **no rest is granted to us**
**B.** as subst. = **space left**, **open space**
5119: נוֹחָה _n.pr.m_. 4th son of Benjamin acc. to [[13-1-chronicles.8.2|1 Ch 8:2]].
5121: נוית Kt (i.e. נָוִית), נָיוֹת Qr; prob. _n.pr.loc_. in Ramah
5125: [נוּן, נִין] _vb_. **propagate**, **increase**;—**Qal** (or **Hiph**. ?) Impf. ינין Kt; > **Niph**. ינּוֹן Qr [[19-psalms.72.17|ψ 72:17]] let his name **have increase** (or, if Niph., **be propagated**, **spread**); but dub.
5126: נוּן and ([[13-1-chronicles.7.27|1 Ch 7:27]]) נוֹן _n.pr.m_. father of Joshua
5127:
נוּס 160 _vb_. **flee**, **escape**
**Qal**
**1.** **flee**
**2.** **escape**
**3.** **take flight**, **depart**, **disappear**
**4.** **fly** (to the attack) **on horseback**.
**Po‛lel** **the breath of** י׳ **driveth at it**, **driveth it on**
**Hithpo‛l**. **in order to take flight before** the bow
**Hiph**.
**1.** **put to flight**
**2.** **drive hastily** to a safe place
**3.** **cause to disappear**, **hide**
5128:
נוּעַ _vb_. **quiver**, **wave**, **waver**, **tremble**, **totter**
**Qal**
**1.** **wave**
**2.** **totter**, **go tottering**
**Niph**. **be tossed about**
**Hiph**.
**1.** **toss about**
**2.** **shake**, **cause to totter**
**3.** (**shake**), **disturb**
**4.** **cause to wander**
5129:
נוֹעַדְיָה _n.pr_. (**meeting with Yah**)
**1.** _m_. Levite, cotemp. Ezra
**2.** _f_. a prophetess hostile to Nehemiah
5130:
[נוּף] _vb_. **move to and fro**, **wave**, **besprinkle**
**Qal** **I have besprinkled my couch with myrrh**
**Po‛lel** **he brandisheth his hand toward the mt.**
**Hiph**.
**1.** **wield**, move to and fro in using it
**2.** **Shake** or **wave** the hand
**3.** **swing** to and fro, as a signal
**4.** Oft. term. techn. in P (H), of rite in which originally the priest lifted his share of offering and **waved** it, i.e. moved it toward altar and back, in token of its presentation to God and its return by him to priest
**5.** **Shed abroad**
**Hoph**. **be waved**
5132:
[נָצַץ] _vb. denom_ **bloom**, **blossom**
**Hiph**. the pomegranates **have put forth blossoms**; the almond-tree **wears blossoms**.
[נָצָה] _vb_. **fly** (?);—only **Qal** Pf. 3 pl. [[25-lamentations.4.15|La 4:15]] (of homeless exiles); text very dub.
5139:
נָזִיר _n.m_. **one consecrated**, **devoted**
**1.** of prince, ruler, as **consecrated**
**2.** specif. of one dedicated to י׳ by vow involving abstinence fr. intoxicants, fr. touching corpse, and fr. cutting hair, **devotee**, **Nazirite**
**3.** = **untrimmed vine**
5141: נֶ֫זֶם _n.m_. **ring**, always of gold when material mentioned
5144:
[נָזַר] _vb_. **dedicate**, **consecrate**, **separate**, in relig. and ceremonial sense
**Niph**. **devote**, **dedicate oneself** unto
**Hiph**. **and ye shale keep the sons of Isr. sacredly separate from their uncleanness**
[נָזַר] _vb. denom_. **Hiph**. **be a Nazarite**, **live as a Nazarite**;—only Nu 6 in law of Naz.
5145:
נֵ֫זֶר _n.m_. [[19-psalms.132.18|ψ 132:18]] **consecration**, **crown**, **Naziriteship**
**1.** **crown** (sign of consecration)
**2.** woman’s **hair** (orig. prob. of long hair as sign of consecration, as in Nazirite vow)
**3.** **consecration**
5147: נַחְבִּי _n.pr.m_. a Naphtalite, one of the Hebrew spies [[04-numbers.13.14|Nu 13:14]] (P).
5152:
נָחוֹר _n.pr.m_.
**1.** father of Teraḥ
**2.** son of Teraḥ and brother of Abr.
5157:
נָחַל _vb. denom_. **get** or **take as a possession**
**Qal**
**1.** **take possession**, **inherit**
**2.** fig. **have** or **get as a possession**, **property**
**3.** **divide the land for a possession**
**Pi**. **divide for a possession**
**Hithp**. **possess oneself of** land
**Hiph**.
**1.** **give as a possession**
**2.** **cause to inherit**, **give as an inheritance**
**Hoph**. **made to possess**
5160: נַחֲלִיאֵל _n.pr.loc_. (= **valley**—or **palm**—**of Ēl**);—station of Isr. E. of Dead Sea
5162:
[נחם] _vb_. **Niph**. **be sorry**, **console oneself**, etc.
**Niph**.
**1.** **be sorry**, **moved to pity**, **have compassion**, for others

**3.** **comfort oneself**, **be comforted**
**4.** **comfort oneself**, **ease oneself**, by taking vengeance
**Piel**—**comfort**, **console**
**Pual**; **be comforted**, **consoled**
**Hithpa**.—
**1.** **be sorry**, **have compassion**
**2.** **rue**, **repent of**
**3.** **comfort oneself**, **be comforted**
**4.** **ease oneself**, by taking vengeance

נָחָשׁ _n.m_. **serpent**
**1.** **serpent**
**2.** bronze image of serpent

5176:
נָחָשׁ _n.pr.m_.
**1.** king of Ammon
**2.** father of Abigail and Zeruiah
**3.** giving name to a city
5177: נַחְשׁוֹן _n.pr.m_. son of Aminadab, of Judah, brother-in-law of Aaron
5178:
נְחֹ֫שֶׁת 137 _n.m_. **copper**, **bronze**
**1.** **copper**
**2.** **fetters of copper** or **bronze**

5181:
[נָחֵת] _vb_. (Aram. and poet.) **go down**, **descend**
**Qal**
**1.** **go down**, **descend**
**2.** fig. **descend** in chastisement
**Niph**. = **penetrate**
**Pi**. **cause to descend** = **press down**
**Hiph**. thither **bring down** thy heroes
5183: נַ֫חַת _n.[m.]_ **descent**;—only cstr., of י׳’s arm of judgment [[23-isaiah.30.30|Is 30:30]]
5184:
נַ֫חַת _n.pr.m_.
**1.** son of Reuel, grandson of Esau
**2.** grandson of Elkanah
**3.** an overseer, Hezekiah's time
5186:
נָטָה 215 _vb_. **stretch out**, **spread out**, **extend**, **incline**, **bend**
**Qal**
**1.**
**a.** **stretch out**, **extend**, hand, rod
**b.** **stretch** line and plummet
**c.** = **offer**
**2.** **Spread out**, i.e. **pitch**, tent
**3.** **Bend**, **turn**, **incline**

**Hiph**.

5193:
נָטַע _vb_. **plant**
**Qal**
**1.** **plant**
**2.** **plant**, fig. = establish
**Niph**. **be planted**, fig., = be established.
5198: נָטָף _n.[m.]_ an odorif. **gum** (gathered in _drops_), used in sacred incense [[02-exodus.30.34|Ex 30:34]] (P).
